title: Build a log cabin lay
kid_text: Stack a small square of sticks.
safety: Wait for coals before a pot goes on.

steps.text: Light a small cone in the center first.
Lay two sticks, then two across them.
Leave gaps so air can move.
Wait for coals before you cook.

mistakes.text: You put a pot on the first flame.
mistakes.fix: Wait until the sticks fall into coals.
